beats.what: The American teenager knocks at a lantern-lit sliding door and the greying older man who answers admits he expected him a day later, blaming the date his mother gave
A young Japanese woman slips out of the flat past the boy with her coat, and the older man drops his eyes, caught out
Inside the cramped one-room flat the older man tells him this stay was the only alternative to juvenile hall, and that he cannot keep moving away from his own trouble
The older man sets the rules he agreed with the boy's mother - school, straight back here, and nowhere near a car - then hands him a coat alcove to sleep in
The older man leaves out an alarm clock, a black school uniform and a handwritten note before going
Lost with a map in the Shibuya rush, he is shoved through the ticket machines onto the wrong train and reaches the school gates after lessons have started

He walks into the lesson late, hands the teacher his transfer paper, and the class works him over for arriving in street shoes without uwabaki - so he helps himself to a pair of slippers from the cubbies
chars: the teacher in the pink cardigan
the long-haired girl at the desk

beats.what: At lunch the student in the white headwrap introduces himself as Twinkie and tries to sell him a laptop, then shoes, then a phone; he refuses, saying he has no cash and will not be here long enough to remember the name
chars: the student in the white headwrap

beats.what: He notices the racing steering wheel lying on the lunch table, asks what the other boy drives and tells him to show it - dropping his own line about not sticking around
chars: the student in the white headwrap

beats.what: The automated street lift delivers the car: a green Hulk-painted minivan with a monster toy in the driver's seat, and he mocks it through the wash bay
chars: the friend in the red beanie

beats.what: An attendant waves the van through a barrier into an underground garage, and the newcomer takes in a packed tuner meet - open hoods, nitrous bottles, dancers, a DJ
chars: the friend in the red beanie

beats.what: He follows the girl from his class to a teal car and flirts over the open hatch; she recognises him from the slipper episode and he asks where she is really from
chars: the girl in the black jacket

beats.what: The spiky-haired man in the black leather jacket rises from his seat and moves through the meet with his crew taking cash and phones - the garage answers to him
chars: the spiky-haired man in the leather jacket

beats.what: The leather-jacket man fronts the American with his crew behind him, pulls the woman cheek to cheek to needle him, calls him gaijin and tells him this is not his scene; she tells him to leave
chars: the American in the grey tee
the spiky-haired man in the leather jacket
the friend in the red beanie

beats.what: His friend warns him that the man is Yakuza, but he calls him out across the floor anyway and the man squares up nose to nose and takes the bait: let's race
chars: the American in the grey tee
the friend in the red beanie
the spiky-haired man in the leather jacket
